description: This file defines classes and methods related to Azure AI Studio integration within a larger language model framework. It includes configuration classes for handling API URLs, environment validation, message transformation, error handling, and request/response processing specific to Azure AI services.

classes.name: AzureFoundryErrorStrings
classes.description: An enumeration of specific error strings related to Azure Foundry errors.

classes.name: AzureAIStudioConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for interacting with Azure AI Studio, extending OpenAIConfig with Azure-specific URL handling, environment validation, message transformation, error handling, and request/response processing logic.

methods.name: List get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported openai parameters, filtering out 'tool_choice' if unsupported by the model.

methods.name: bool _supports_stop_reason(self, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if a model supports stop reason tokens, with special handling for 'grok' models via XAIChatConfig.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and prepares headers for API request, setting authorization header based on environment and API key.

methods.name: bool _should_use_api_key_header(self, api_base: str)
methods.description: Determines if the API URL should use the 'api-key' header based on hostname.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL with appropriate path and query parameters for Azure AI.

methods.name: List[ProviderField] get_required_params(self)
methods.description: Returns the required provider fields and descriptions for Azure AI Studio configuration.

methods.name: List _transform_messages( self, messages: List[AllMessageValues], model: str, )
methods.description: Transforms message contents to string if they are not images or audio, suitable for Azure AI Studio.

methods.name: bool _is_azure_openai_model(self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str])
methods.description: Checks if a model is an Azure OpenAI variant based on model name and supported model lists.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str],str] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], custom_llm_provider: str, )
methods.description: Provides provider info (URL, API key, provider name) suitable for Azure OpenAI models.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Enhances request data, integrating extra body content and removing retries before calling super.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Adjusts the model identifier in the response to indicate Azure AI.

methods.name: bool should_retry_llm_api_inside_llm_translation_on_http_error( self, e: httpx.HTTPStatusError, litellm_params: dict )
methods.description: Decides whether an API error warrants a retry based on specific error messages.

methods.name: int max_retry_on_unprocessable_entity_error(self)
methods.description: Defines maximum number of retries for unprocessable entity errors (set to 2).

methods.name: dict transform_request_on_unprocessable_entity_error(self, e: httpx.HTTPStatusError, request_data: dict)
methods.description: Modifies request data upon certain errors, including removing index parameters.

methods.name: dict _drop_extra_params_from_request_data(self, request_data: dict, error_text: str)
methods.description: Removes specific parameters from request data based on error messages.

methods.name: Optional[List[str]] _extract_params_to_drop_from_error_text(self, error_text: str)
methods.description: Parses error text to extract parameter names that should be dropped from requests.
